title: Unique flat-model normalization of the étale scalar tensor comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme, A→B any map of commutative rings, E the sheafified ordinary extension of constant coefficients on the small étale site, and F the published chosen left adjoint to exact derived restriction. The ordinary oplax structure of E is the adjoint mate of the fixed lax restriction structure. Let rP be the fixed scalarExtensionRepresentative counit. There exists a unique natural family μ(K,L):FK tensor_B^L FL≅F(K tensor_A^L L) whose inverse satisfies the cochain counit equation of EtaleHomTensorModelNormalization on every pair of flat-term K-flat complexes. No flatness of B over A is required. The accompanying interface definitions fix the evaluation transpose, naturality, signed Hom shifts and exactness predicates used by the parent statement.

proof.text: Ordinary scalar extension preserves flat objects: test at geometric stalks, commute stalks with extension, and use flat base change of modules. It preserves K-flat quasi-isomorphisms: after faithful exact restriction it is tensoring with the coefficient sheaf, which sends acyclic K-flat complexes to acyclic complexes.

Give E the ordinary adjoint-mate oplax structure. Sheafified strong monoidal extension supplies the compatible strong monoidal structure. Identify the chosen F with LE by uniqueness of left adjoints to exact restriction. The cochain counit formula identifies its transported derived counit with the fixed rP.

Apply the general right exact normalized binary comparison theorem to E, F and this isomorphism. Its naturality equations and flat-model normalization are definitionally the three clauses of IsEtaleHomTensorCanonical.
